'''Beldiss''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
He was one of the most high ranking Imperial [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]] on [[Voss]] along with [[Darth Serevin]]. His plan was to take failed [[Voss Mystics]] in order to teach them the ways of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], thus reducing the need for an alliance with the [[Voss (species)|Voss]] in favor of increased quantities of Voss Sith. Lord Beldiss utilized his smooth charm to continually show the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in a bad light, earning a rival in [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] [[Jannik (Human)|Jannik]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameLS}}
Eventually, when a Republic traveling hero uncovered his plans, Beldiss invited him to his base in the [[Ruined City]] to show that his new Voss acolytes willingly joined the Sith. But when his acolytes considered joining the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], Beldiss refused to lose his initiates after so much effort. He attacked the hero, but was [[Death/Legends|killed]], with the Voss joining the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}
